design_detail: Wealth tax for resource mobilisation and lower inequality (before the FY2015 budget)
quote_original: Time has come to impose tax on wealth, at least for resource mobilisation and to reduce inequality
source_title: Professor Mustafizur Rahman on wealth tax
grading_note: Names a wealth tax without specifics; the page carries his own words.

design_detail: Direct tax on net wealth replacing the income-tax-linked wealth surcharge; NBR plan of 0.25% to 1% above Tk 4 crore
quote_original: Many countries impose direct wealth taxes rather than surcharges linked to income tax
source_title: Direct wealth tax needed for fairer distribution of wealth: Professor Mustafizur Rahman
publisher: Centre for Policy Dialogue (from The Business Standard)
grading_note: Backs the named NBR proposal for a direct tax on net assets in place of the surcharge, with rates and threshold; the page title states the position.

design_detail: Shift from VAT toward direct taxes and wealth taxes
quote_original: This needs to shift towards direct taxation and wealth taxes if revenue is to be increased sustainably.
source_title: CPD sees disconnect between budget goals, implementation plan
grading_note: Names wealth taxes among the direct taxes to rely on; no design.

design_detail: Separate wealth tax with a carefully designed slab structure
quote_original: a separate wealth tax could still be justified if its slab structure is carefully designed
source_title: Govt may drop planned wealth tax, bike and rickshaw AIT
grading_note: Reported in the reporter's words, with Rahman as the stated source; he also warns about capital flight.

design_detail: Mandatory wealth tax; CPD estimate of Tk 6,000 crore extra
quote_original: For this reason, the introduction of a mandatory wealth tax has become inevitable.
source_title: CPD proposes inheritance tax to reduce wealth inequality
grading_note: Keynote presentation of the CPD study on property taxation, recommending a mandatory wealth tax.

design_detail: Wealth taxation over income taxation
quote_original: This justifies the need to focus on wealth taxation more than income taxation.
source_title: Hike property tax to curb accumulation of wealth, inequality
publisher: The Daily Star via Asia News Network
grading_note: Same event; names wealth taxation without a design.

design_detail: Inheritance tax as part of a wealth tax; extra Tk 6,000 crore
quote_original: The Center for Policy Dialogue (CPD) has proposed imposing an inheritance tax as part of a wealth tax to reduce wealth inequality in the country and increase revenue collection.
source_title: CPD proposes inheritance tax to reduce wealth inequality
grading_note: The study covers property and inheritance taxes as well; graded B because the wealth tax is named but not designed.

design_detail: Direct wealth tax replacing the wealth surcharge
quote_original: Direct wealth tax needed for fairer distribution of wealth: Professor Mustafizur Rahman
source_title: Direct wealth tax needed for fairer distribution of wealth: Professor Mustafizur Rahman
grading_note: CPD published the headline on its own site; the position is its Distinguished Fellow's.

design_detail: Wealth tax against rising income and asset inequality
quote_original: Mustafa K Mujeri, director general of Bangladesh Institute of Development Studies (BIDS), said wealth tax should be introduced to rein in rising income and asset inequality, which has become a challenge for Bangladesh.
source_title: Professor Mustafizur Rahman on wealth tax
publisher: Centre for Policy Dialogue (from the press)
grading_note: Reporter narrates a statement with Mujeri as the clear source.

design_detail: Tax on wealth
quote_original: Binayak Sen, a research director at BIDS, who has been trying persistently to make the government understand why the country needs to impose tax on wealth.
source_title: Professor Mustafizur Rahman on wealth tax
publisher: Centre for Policy Dialogue (from the press)
grading_note: Reporter's description of his position, not his own words.

design_detail: Wealth tax to curb wealth accumulation
quote_original: So, if we really want to ensure affordable housing and curb wealth accumulation, wealth tax is necessary.
source_title: Hike property tax to curb accumulation of wealth, inequality
publisher: The Daily Star via Asia News Network
grading_note: His own words at the CPD dialogue; no design. His call for an inheritance tax is not recorded.

design_detail: Wealth and inheritance taxes among reforms
quote_original: plugging loopholes in the tax system, and introducing wealth and inheritance taxes.
source_title: Are Bangladesh's tax policies addressing inequality?
publisher: The Daily Star via Asia News Network
grading_note: Reporter narrates his suggestions ("He" is Rizwanul Islam in the article); no design.

design_detail: Revision of the wealth tax, inheritance tax
quote_original: Revision of wealth tax, institution of inheritance tax, and a widening of the tax net to bring higher-income groups within its ambit are required.
source_title: Overcoming tax reform challenges in Bangladesh
grading_note: His own words, but "revision of wealth tax" may mean the surcharge; kept at C.

design_detail: Progressive taxation on wealth and inheritance, prioritised
quote_original: Progressive taxation on wealth and inheritance must be prioritised.
source_title: Re-strategising the Economy and Mobilizing Resources for Equitable and Sustainable Development (final report)
grading_note: The report itself says "progressive taxation on wealth", with no design; Prothom Alo's phrase "wealth tax" (second row) is the reporter's.

design_detail: Surcharge at the higher of 0.1% of net wealth or 30% of tax payable, for net wealth of Tk 500 million and above
quote_original: An individual taxpayer having a net wealth of Tk 500 million or above will have to pay higher of 0.1 percent of net wealth or 30 percent of his income tax payable as surcharge
source_title: Finance minister proposes 0.1% surcharge for wealth over Tk 500m
grading_note: Budget speech; the 0.1% floor is levied on net wealth but the tool is a surcharge, so B with doubt.

design_detail: Draft: 0.25% to 1% on net wealth above Tk 4 crore, replacing the surcharge
quote_original: NBR officials believe this method yields far lower revenue than a direct wealth tax system.
source_title: Direct wealth tax needed for fairer distribution of wealth: Professor Mustafizur Rahman
publisher: Centre for Policy Dialogue (from The Business Standard)
grading_note: The NBR drafted the tax; the government dropped it before the budget (Daily Star, 4 June 2026). Graded B because the quote is the reporter's.

design_detail: Reorganise and expand the wealth tax system
quote_original: Examples include reorganising and expanding the wealth tax system
source_title: What is the economic path to avoid future 'Red July'?
grading_note: His own words; "wealth tax system" is the surcharge, hence C. The column also computes a 5% wealth tax on 195 people.

design_detail: Wealth tax on personal and inherited assets (as reported)
quote_original: According to the report, a wealth tax should be levied on both personal and inherited assets to prevent the concentration of wealth in the hands of a few.
source_title: Collecting additional taxes from the rich recommended
grading_note: Press summary of the report; the report's own wording is the first row.

design_detail: Wealth tax as an alternative to the surcharge
quote_original: সম্পদ কর চালু করা গেলে সম্পদশালী ব্যক্তিদের কাছ থেকে আয়করের বাইরে অতিরিক্ত রাজস্ব আদায় সম্ভব হবে এবং সারচার্জের বিকল্প হিসেবে এটি কার্যকর হতে পারে।
quote_en: If a wealth tax can be introduced, extra revenue beyond income tax can be collected from wealthy people, and it can work as an alternative to the surcharge.
source_title: সম্পদ কর ও উত্তরাধিকার করের পরিকল্পনা এনবিআরের
grading_note: NBR Chairman in his opening remarks: a wealth tax would raise extra revenue and work as an alternative to the surcharge. Reported speech.

design_detail: Exploring reintroduction of a wealth tax
quote_original: We are exploring the possibility of reintroducing a wealth tax
source_title: FY27: NBR mulls wealth, inheritance taxes, tighter exemptions
grading_note: An official exploring an option; C. The plan was dropped in June 2026.

design_detail: Wealth tax for revenue and lower inequality
quote_original: A wealth tax could have been a useful tool both for raising revenue and reducing inequality.
source_title: Govt may drop wealth tax, black money indemnity plans
grading_note: His own words to TBS, saying it is not justified to abandon the proposal.

design_detail: Wealth tax for revenue and lower inequality
quote_original: এই প্রেক্ষাপটে সম্পদ কর আরোপ রাজস্ব আদায় বৃদ্ধি ও বৈষম্য হ্রাসে কার্যকর ভূমিকা রাখতে পারে।
quote_en: In this context, imposing a wealth tax can play an effective role in raising revenue and reducing inequality.
source_title: সারচার্জের বদলে চালু হচ্ছে সম্পদ কর, যেভাবে নির্ধারিত হবে
grading_note: Says a wealth tax can work for revenue and equality, with a caution on valuation. Second-hand report of a Jugantor interview.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the rich, in the FY2026-27 budget debate
quote_original: He proposed VAT cuts, wealth tax on the rich and tax reforms
source_title: BNP calls budget pro-people, Jamaat criticises inflation risk and debt dependence
grading_note: Parliamentary speech, in the reporter's words; the MP is named. No design.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the rich, in the FY2026-27 budget debate
quote_original: তিনি ভ্যাট কমানো, ধনীদের ওপর সম্পদ কর আরোপ এবং করনীতি সংস্কারের প্রস্তাব দেন।
quote_en: He proposed cutting VAT, imposing a wealth tax on the rich, and reforming tax policy.
source_title: বাজেট জনমুখী, বলছে বিএনপি; মূল্যস্ফীতি ও ঋণনির্ভরতার সমালোচনায় জামায়াত
grading_note: Bengali version of the same report.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the rich and on large holdings of shares and bonds
quote_original: রাজস্ব আহরণের ক্ষেত্রে দরিদ্রদের ওপর প্রত্যক্ষ করের বোঝা না বাড়িয়ে ধনী-বিত্তশালীদের ওপর সম্পদ কর আরোপ করতে হবে
quote_en: To raise revenue, a wealth tax must be imposed on the rich and well-off, without raising the burden of direct taxes on the poor.
source_title: ধনীদের ওপর করের হার বাড়ানোর পরামর্শ
grading_note: The association's pre-budget proposals for FY2022-23; also asks for a wealth tax on the big holders of shares and bonds.

design_detail: "Property and Wealth Tax" among the revenue reforms
quote_original: Property and Wealth Tax
source_title: BNP Election Manifesto 2026 (English)
publisher: The Business Standard (PDF of the manifesto)
grading_note: A heading in the manifesto's revenue chart with no design and no rate; "property" may mean property tax, so C. The BNP government later dropped the NBR plan.

design_detail: Targeted inheritance or net-wealth levy of 0.3% of GDP, as an illustration
quote_original: If a targeted inheritance or net-wealth levy raised only 0.3% of GDP annually, that could amount to roughly $1.5-1.7 billion a year.
source_title: Like Other Governments, Bangladesh Will Also Need to Consider a Wealth Tax
grading_note: His column argues for taxing wealth but prefers property and inheritance levies; the net-wealth levy is an example, hence C.

design_detail: Wealth tax now compulsory and inevitable, on a fair and transparent basis, not at high rates
quote_original: সম্পদ করের প্রচলন বাধ্যতামূলক ও অবশ্যম্ভাবী হয়ে গেছে
quote_en: the introduction of a wealth tax has become compulsory and inevitable.
source_title: ‘পূর্বাচল এখন ট্যাক্স হ্যাভেনে পরিণত হয়েছে’
grading_note: Keynote of the CPD dialogue "Opportunities for collecting wealth tax"; the Bengali report of the statement quoted in English by The Business Standard.

design_detail: Focus on wealth taxation rather than income taxation
quote_original: This justifies the need to focus on wealth taxation more than income taxation
source_title: Presentation on State and Scope of Property Taxation in Bangladesh
grading_note: Slide of the CPD study presentation; the study centres on property tax and the surcharge.

design_detail: Revised wealth tax replacing the surcharge, on declared net wealth
quote_original: the revenue authority is considering replacing the existing wealth surcharge with a revised wealth tax to widen the tax net and boost revenue mobilisation
source_title: NBR plans wealth tax revival
grading_note: Reporter's account of the NBR's FY27 proposals; the government dropped the plan in June 2026.

design_detail: Wealth tax system inside a progressive tax system
quote_original: The system of wealth tax and special taxation on luxury items can also be included in a
source_title: Time for structural reform of state revenue and expenditure
grading_note: Part 2 of the same column; "wealth tax" is the existing surcharge, hence C.
